entries.6a0d0a813d19731e: The consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with [[term:ifrs|IFRS]]. Operating profit for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,099 million (up 30.8% year on year), profit before tax was ¥3,029 million (¥1,910 million in the previous year), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥1,779 million (¥2,013 million in the previous year). Segment profit in the annual securities report was ¥4,477 million for the online travel business (¥4,149 million in the previous year) and ¥104 million for the investment business, while the IT offshore development business recorded a loss of ¥106 million; the adjustment for corporate expenses and other items not attributable to each segment was a negative ¥1,375 million. The annual securities report states that although growth in the online travel business slowed further, the investment business (AirTrip CVC) lifted profit, which had a profit-increasing effect. In addition, consolidated impairment losses were ¥532 million, all of which are included in the online travel business in the segment notes.
entries.6a70926939894cbb: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the group conducts business in three [[term:segment|segments]]: the “Online Travel Business,” the “IT Offshore Development Business” and the “Investment Business.” The main Online Travel Business allows domestic and overseas travel content to be compared and booked on the company’s own website, “AirTrip,” and also provides travel content to other companies’ media. Airline tickets and similar products are arranged by the company acting as agent, and sales commissions and other fees are recognised as revenue. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥28,104 million (up 5.8% year on year), of which the Online Travel Business accounted for ¥27,744 million, the Investment Business ¥345 million and the IT Offshore Development Business ¥14 million. The annual securities report states that no single external customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue.

entries.7555b58edf7bdc9a: This is a business, operated by the company itself, that sells air tickets, travel and hotels. It offers a BtoC service, through its directly operated site 'AirTrip', where users compare and book domestic and overseas travel content, and a BtoBtoC service (OEM provision) that supplies domestic air tickets and travel, and overseas air tickets and hotels, to other companies' media as travel content. The securities report cites 'purchasing power', 'diverse sales channels' and 'system development capability' as its three strengths, and states that its domestic air ticket handling is the largest in the industry and that its partnerships with each airline and East Japan Railway Company contribute to its competitiveness.

It also operates the AI solutions business 'AlgorHrm', which specializes in the HR field.

entries.bb030059679ffdb3: This is the business in which the subsidiary Inbound Platform Co., Ltd. provides services for travelers visiting Japan and foreign residents living in Japan. In the Mobile Network Business, it rents out Wi-Fi routers, sells and brokers SIM and eSIM cards, and sells mobile accessories, and it operates the Web site "Guromoba" for inbound travelers. In the Life Media Tech Business, it offers "Japan Bullet Train," a multilingual Shinkansen ticket arrangement service; "Airport Taxi," a reservation brokerage service for chauffeured car companies centered on airport transfers; and "Clinic Nearme," which provides overseas travel-related information to foreign residents and supports procedures for medical care and testing.
entries.bbf2f21296ed1f83: A reportable segment that combines multiple travel-related businesses, centered on the business of selling airline tickets, travel and hotels over the internet, together with inbound travel to Japan, media, regional revitalization and cloud services. The Company has operated as a travel company specializing in online services since its founding. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥27,744 million (up 12.7% from ¥24,624 million in the previous fiscal year), and segment profit was ¥4,477 million (¥4,149 million in the previous fiscal year). The securities report explains the increase in revenue as due to higher demand for inbound travel to Japan, while also stating that there are signs of slowing growth in the AirTrip Travel business.

entries.cee6f01370c931ab: The core of the online travel business is a BtoC service on its directly operated site "AirTrip," where users can compare and book domestic and overseas travel content, and BtoBtoC (OEM provision of travel content), which provides domestic airline tickets and tours, and overseas airline tickets and hotels to other companies' media. The securities report cites "purchasing power," "diverse sales channels" and "system development capability" as strengths, and writes that handling of domestic airline tickets at the largest scale in the industry and partnerships with airlines and East Japan Railway Company, among others, are sources of competitiveness. In addition, subsidiaries operate Wi-Fi rental for inbound tourists, email newsletters and WEB media, cloud services for the accommodation and food service industries, recruitment support, car rental in Okinawa and other businesses. The IT offshore development business provides lab-type development services in Ho Chi Minh and Hanoi, Vietnam. The investment business nurtures investments in growing companies, and the cumulative number of investees is 145. Purchases of domestic airline tickets, one of the main products, involve large amounts per supplier; the securities report shows that in the fiscal year ended September 2025, All Nippon Airways Co., Ltd. accounted for ¥17,027 million (43.4% as shown in the table) and Skymark Inc. for ¥4,955 million (12.6%), and cites high dependence on specific suppliers in the business risks.

entries.d8b1f70bf136d1be: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥28,104 million (up 5.8% year on year). Revenue was ¥27,744 million in the online travel business (up 12.7% year on year), ¥345 million in the investment business (down 80.7%) and ¥14 million in the IT offshore development business (down 90.9%). The annual securities report states that the increase in revenue was due to the increase in online travel business revenue accompanying growth in demand for inbound travel. As for revenue recognition, travel products such as air tickets are arranged by the company as an agent, and sales commissions and the like are recognized as revenue on a net basis at the time of ticket issuance. Packages combining air tickets and hotels are recognized as revenue on a gross basis, based on completion of the trip (return date). For offshore development, service fees for labor provision received from customers are recognized in line with operating results; for the investment business, changes in the fair value of investments are recognized as investment gains or losses, and the sale price is recognized as revenue upon sale. The annual securities report separately shows the online travel business's transaction volume at ¥100,937 million (down 6.2% year on year), but does not print the definition of transaction volume or its relationship to revenue.
entries.da40567fdb046edb: A business running an invitation-only community of business executives, operated by listed companies and companies preparing to list within the AirTrip Group. As a place where corporate executives gather, it holds regular meetings, study sessions, large venture events with 2,000 participants, and more.
entries.dc490b9b8851df63: A business carried out by the subsidiaries Kanzashi Inc. and N's Enterprise Inc. It aims to expand the exchange population and revitalize regional economies by solving social issues such as labor shortages and overtourism (a problem that arises when tourists concentrate in specific areas) through solutions centered on "tourism tech" × "HR tech." As specific services, the securities report lists tourism tech that expands the exchange population, and HR tech for addressing labor shortages and making shift management more efficient.
entries.dddf7195ca707e7a: This business provides lab-type development services, mainly in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi in Vietnam, to customers such as companies in E-commerce, Web solutions, games and system development (the reportable segment overview also lists BPO services). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥14 million (down 90.9% from ¥154 million in the previous year), and segment loss was ¥106 million (compared with a loss of ¥228 million in the previous year). The securities report states that revenue from this business is determined by charging customers the monthly unit rate per person (the rate for one person working for one month) multiplied by the number of staff, so the number of new labs opened and changes in staff at existing labs have a major impact. EVOLABLE ASIA CO., LTD., a consolidated subsidiary in Vietnam (voting rights ownership 51.0%), develops the company's systems, and NAYUTA Co., Ltd., which the company made a subsidiary in September 2025 and which develops, maintains and operates ticket sales systems, is also a consolidated subsidiary in this segment. In addition, Hybrid Technologies Co., Ltd., which changed from an associate to a consolidated subsidiary on October 1, 2025, was an equity-method affiliate as of September 30, 2025; the securities report states that its impact on consolidated results is 'under review at this time'.
